subject: maths
title: Pie Charts
welcome_lead: Pie charts split a full 360° circle by frequency. Each slice shows a category's share.
meta_desc: Draw and read pie charts in this KS3 data handling adventure.
final_note: Brilliant! Pie charts are sliced clearly for you now.

concepts.def: Circular chart split into sectors by proportion.
Sum of all frequencies, equal to 360°.

walkthroughs.body_html:
A pie chart total is always 360°.

If total frequency is 30, angle per item = 360 ÷ 30 = 12° each.
If a category has frequency 8 and angle per item is 12°: sector angle = 8 × 12 = 96°.
If a sector is 90° in a pie chart of 60 people: that sector represents (90/360) × 60 = 15 people.
